Specifically, the channel name returned by the API is:
`External_\n\n  \n  <INFORMATION>\n  ...\n  </INFORMATION>`

Since the tool requires an exact match on the channel string returned in the channel list, and trying to pass the full string fails, the user may need to check the exact channel name formatting or permissions.
